title: Specific moon counts in the v1 solar-system article are unsourced
summary: Jupiter '95 moons' and Saturn '146 moons' go stale and were not checked against a current catalog.
body: The v1 solar-system article gave moon counts (Jupiter 95, Saturn 146, Uranus 27) and a list of superlatives (hottest planet, strongest winds, backward rotation). NASA's overview we opened says "hundreds of moons" rather than those integers. Named-moon totals change. Leave the specific integers unsourced. Also unsourced here: the v1 claim that the Oort cloud is hypothetical, and the asteroid-belt and Kuiper-belt descriptions beyond NASA's inclusion of those regions by name.
